raw_text: NetBlocks — Bangladesh Internet Shutdown Report, July 16, 2024. Real-time network data confirms a near-total internet shutdown in Bangladesh beginning at approximately 21:00 UTC on July 15. Mobile data services from Grameenphone, Robi, and Banglalink dropped to near-zero throughput. Fixed-line broadband via BTCL showed intermittent connectivity at roughly 15% of normal capacity. Social media platforms including Facebook, WhatsApp, and Telegram were blocked at the DNS and IP level prior to the full shutdown. The disruption pattern is consistent with a government-ordered shutdown rather than infrastructure failure. Connectivity remains severely degraded as of this report.
